claims.statement: For the complex 32-dimensional Spin(11) spinor S, S* tensor S tensor S decomposes as the sum over r=0..5 of T_r with multiplicity 6-r, where T_r has highest weight (3/2 repeated r, 1/2 repeated 5-r) and dimension 32(C(11,r)-C(11,r-1)).
assumptions: The standard Spin(11) spinor and Clifford exterior-form identification End(S)=sum_{j=0}^5 Lambda^j R^11.
Gamma-trace contraction gives the stated spinor-form recursion.
claims.costs: The 32768-dimensional triple tensor product is reduced to six highest-weight spaces of dimensions 243, 81, 27, 9, 3, 1 and multiplicities 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.

claims.statement: For every alpha in R_+^5, the full ordinary-tensor Spin(11) star obeys lambda_max(H_alpha) <= sum_k C(11,k) alpha_k + max_{v in V} v dot alpha, where V={(1,5,5,10,10),(0,2,7,8,14),(1,1,1,14,14),(0,0,5,10,16)} are moments of explicit pure seeds.
assumptions: The five-qubit Jordan-Wigner Clifford model and declared Choi/star convention are correct.
The highest-weight kernels and output-swap decomposition cover all 32768 dimensions.
claims.costs: Exact rational Gram-metric block calculation; no floating-point SDP grid; no proof-assistant verification.

claims.statement: Every Spin(11)-covariant unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint channel on M_32 with a CPTP two-output extension having both marginals equal to the channel admits one full-domain canonical EB channel Psi with Psi >= 2 Phi - id on Hermitian matrices. Psi is a convex mixture of four full-domain Spin(11)-orbit POVM channels from the listed seeds.
assumptions: The input and output representation is the complex 32-dimensional irreducible Spin(11) spinor.
Phi is CPTP, unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint, and Spin(11)-covariant.
A CPTP two-output broadcaster with both marginals Phi exists.
The all-mixed seed-support star certificate above holds.
claims.support_statement: The convex hull of four attained canonical-EB orbit-channel transfer vectors is a feasible subset of the full canonical-EB transfer set. Its positive-dual support suffices by separation. The full canonical-EB support is not asserted equal to this subset support.
claims.falsifier: A missing star block, incorrect seed moment, negative exact principal minor, or a legal channel satisfying the assumptions but violating every such comparator would falsify the claim.

claims.statement: For every positive invariant dual Q=sum_{k=1}^5 alpha_k Pi_k, the support over all full-domain canonical EB channels satisfies S_can(alpha) <= max_{j=3,4,5}{31 alpha_j, alpha_1+30 alpha_j, 5 alpha_2+26 alpha_j, alpha_1+5 alpha_2+25 alpha_j}.
assumptions: Canonical measure-and-prepare prepares each normalized POVM effect state.
The Clifford basis is Hermitian and orthonormal under tau=Tr/32.
Clifford anticommutation yields s1<=1 and SO(11) skew normal form yields s2<=5 for pure states; Parseval gives sum s_k=31.
claims.support_statement: This is a valid upper bound over every full-domain canonical EB channel, not an exact formula and not a description of the canonical-EB transfer set.
claims.remaining_blocker: Exact S_can requires optimizing alpha dot s(psi) over all complex pure spinor rays CP^31; the four-seed feasible subset and 12-vertex outer bound do not classify the full moment image.

checks: Each seed's moments sum to 31 by exact Parseval replay over all 1023 nonidentity Clifford words.
